title: AVCG: A Generalized Variational Framework for Counterfactual Generation under Hypothesis Distributions
abstract: arXiv:2609.07917v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Counterfactual explanations formalize "what-if" scenarios by identifying modifications to an input instance that obtain a desired alternative prediction. Traditionally, whether generated via instance-specific optimization or amortized single pass models, these approaches rely on a single, deterministic point-estimate predictor. However, this ignores predictive uncertainty and hypothesis variability, leading to brittle explanations that frequently become invalid if the underlying model is retrained or updated. To address this fragility, we propose the Amortized Variational Counterfactual Generator (AVCG), a generalized optimization framework that formulates counterfactual generation as optimization over an arbitrary distribution of plausible predictive hypotheses rather than a single deterministic predictor. translated_title: AVCG：假设分布下反事实生成的广义变分框架
translated_abstract: 反事实解释通过识别对输入实例的修改来形式化“如果……会怎样”的场景，从而获得期望的替代预测。传统上，无论是通过实例特定优化还是摊销式单次前向模型生成，这些方法都依赖于单一的、确定性的点估计预测器。然而，这忽略了预测的不确定性和假设的可变性，导致解释变得脆弱——当底层模型被重新训练或更新时，这些解释经常会失效。为了解决这种脆弱性，我们提出了摊销式变分反事实生成器（AVCG），这是一个广义的优化框架，它将反事实生成表述为对合理预测假设的任意分布进行优化，而非针对单一的确定性预测器进行优化。这一表述自然地兼容了贝叶斯后验、Rashomon受限假设空间以及其他不确定性表示。
tldr: 提出AVCG框架，将反事实生成从依赖单一确定性预测器推广为对任意合理预测假设分布进行变分优化，有效解决了模型重训练或更新后解释失效的脆弱性问题。
